# parseWidget {#parse-widget}

`parseWidget` returns the lowercase widget id for a name. [[surface:symbol:parseWidget]]

## Behavior

`parseWidget` requires a non-empty name and returns its lowercase id. [[behavior:parseWidget.returns-id]]

## Prerequisites

The package is installed, and `parseWidget` is imported from `src/index.ts`. [[source:src/index.ts:6]]

## Example

```js test
import { parseWidget } from "@site/src/index.ts";
console.log(parseWidget("Bolt").id);
```

```output
bolt
```

## Limitations

The name is trimmed, so two names that differ only in surrounding spaces share an id. [[behavior:parseWidget.returns-id]]
